questions.q: Which technique is the plucking of a string on a violin?
questions.why: Pizzicato means plucked; arco means bowed.

options: A button accordion used in tango
questions.why: The bandoneón is a button accordion typical of the tango orquesta típica.

questions.q: Which term describes many notes sung to one syllable?
questions.why: A melisma is several notes on one syllable; syllabic is one note per syllable.

questions.q: Describe two differences between the harpsichord and the piano.
questions.model: The harpsichord's strings are plucked, giving a bright metallic tone, and it cannot change volume by touch, so dynamics are terraced; the piano's strings are struck by hammers and can play louder or softer.
